enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Bend knees. Straighten legs. Turn to right side. Move arm under pillow. Pull blanket up. Push blanket down. Turn to back. Stretch legs. Remain still.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up, brushing teeth, and getting dressed for work
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Wash face. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom. Put on clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, making coffee with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out food. Close refrigerator. Crack eggs into bowl. Eat breakfast. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Pour hot water into cup. Add coffee. Stir coffee. Drink coffee.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the morning clinical shift
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Open front door. Step outside. Close and lock door. Walk to bus stop. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, attending patients and clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Put on scrubs. Wash hands. Attend morning briefing. Pick up clipboard. Visit patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Take notes. Walk to nurses' station. Use computer to update records. Attend patient. Perform clinical duties. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to duty. Attend more patients. Complete paperwork. End shift.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Get off bus. Walk home. Open front door. Enter home. Close door. Lock door.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and changing out of work clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Undress. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wash body. Wash hair. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Dry body. Put on clean clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner, using the induction cooker and microwave
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil. Add meat. Stir meat. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Turn off induction cooker. Transfer food to plate. Sit down. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear table.

enriched_activities.activity: Loading and running the washing machine for laundry
enriched_activities.desc: Collect dirty clothes. Walk to bathroom. Open washing machine door. Load clothes into washing machine. Add detergent. Close washing machine door. Set wash cycle. Press start button. Walk away.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Scroll through channels. Stop on a show. Put remote down. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit down. Drink. Change channel. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to review clinical notes and continuing education material
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to computer. Sit down. Turn on computer. Log in. Open clinical notes file. Read notes. Scroll down. Take notes in notebook. Open continuing education material. Read material. Highlight text. Save file. Close file. Shut down computer. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Night washing up and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

Walk into bedroom. Turn on bedside lamp. Change into pajamas. Set alarm on phone. Plug phone into charger. Pick up book. Read book. Put book down. Turn off bedside lamp. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Breathe slowly. Turn to right side. Remain still.
